paper_title: Constraints on bosonic dark matter from ultralow-field nuclear magnetic resonance
coupling_convention: g_aNN (ALP wind–nucleon linear coupling) in GeV^-1, plotted exactly as on the y-axis
notes: CASPEr-ZULF (Cosmic Axion Spin Precession Experiment, zero-to-ultralow-field NMR on 13C-formic acid). Main result Fig.3 constrains the ALP wind-nucleon linear coupling g_aNN with y-axis in GeV^-1 (a dimensionful derivative coupling, NOT the standard dimensionless g_an), assuming g_app = g_ann = g_aNN. Mass range 1.8e-16 to 7.8e-14 eV (45 mHz to 19 Hz). Coupling limit worsens ~linearly with frequency since sideband amplitude ~ B/omega. Coupling type ambiguous: paper treats both proton (1H) and neutron (13C) equally; hint says AxionProton and 1H proton spin dominates sensitivity, but it is genuinely a nucleon coupling. Data points are approximate readings from Fig.3 (log-log plot); paper also reports quadratic wind (Fig.4) and dark-photon dEDM/dMDM (Fig.5, DarkPhoton) couplings. 90% CL.
